about_the_game:
Suit up and let your enemies feel the sting! Channel the power of the strong, sleek, and unstoppable "Stinging Fury" cosmetic set, for Troopers who strike with style and precision.

Includes:

  • Stinging Fury "Venomous" Helmet Decal

  • Stinging Fury Weapon Skin

  • Stinging Fury Helmet Visor

  • Stinging Fury Uniform Palette

  • Stinging Fury HUD Nameplate: Emblem

  • Stinging Fury HUD Nameplate: Frame

  • Stinging Fury HUD Nameplate: Background

  • Stinging Fury Player Banner: Medal

  • Stinging Fury Player Banner: Ribbon

  • Stinging Fury Player Banner: Background
